name: @ibgib/ts-gib
description: ibgib library with low-level graphing-related substrate functionality, e.g. creating raw ibgibs and transformations. node19+ needed for heavily-used webcrypto hashing isomorphically consumed in node and browsers (apps).

scripts.build:link: npm uninstall --global @ibgib/ts-gib && npm ls --global --link=true && npm link
scripts.man:build:link: echo 'builds and relinks this package AFTER first removing the global package. Otherwise will get a permission denied error after build when attempting to use the ibgib cmd from commandline.'
scripts.test:both: npm run build:test && npm run test:node:nobuild && npm run test:browser:nobuild
scripts.man:test:both: use this if you want to test in both node and browser contexts
scripts.man:test:node: use this if you want to build+test in node
scripts.man:test:node:nobuild: use this if you want to test in node but its already built
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:test && echo "not implemented yet"
scripts.man:test:browser: use this if you want to build+test only the browser context
scripts.man:test:browser:nobuild: use this if you want to test only the browser context but its already built
scripts.test:browser:serve: npm run build:test && echo "not implemented yet"
scripts.man:test:browser:serve: use this if you want to build+test in the browser and don't want the browser to close when your done. (i.e. you're debugging)
scripts.man:test:browser:serve:nobuild: use this if you are troubleshooting existing dist output and don't want to overwrite those files. (and you're debugging in the browser)
scripts.prepare:publish:minor: npm run clean && npm version minor && npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.prepare:publish: npm run clean && npm version patch && npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.man:prepare:publish: use this to patch > build > pack for publishing to npm repo

author: William Raiford
